name: Freya Kaya
headline: Software Engineer in Test
summary: Software Engineer in Test with experience building reliable test coverage across web applications and backend services. Comfortable working in Agile teams to improve release confidence, reduce regressions, and keep product quality high. Brings a practical approach to automation, defect investigation, and collaboration with developers and product partners.

roles.title: Software Engineer in Test
bullets: Built automated checks for Angular and React interfaces using Jest and HTML/CSS, improving coverage for core user flows.
Developed test suites in TypeScript and Python with pytest to validate business logic and catch regressions earlier.
Supported backend verification in Java by pairing exploratory checks with repeatable scripted scenarios, reducing escaped defects by 27%.
Worked in Agile delivery cycles with engineers and analysts to refine acceptance criteria and keep testing aligned with sprint goals.
